scope: In-place PrepFlow study improvements. Existing original travel homepage retained. Local only, not deployed.
changes: An immediate three-dinner week makes the first useful task available without an account or questionnaire; optional preferences can be skipped and later affect unstarted meals only.
Weekly ingredient totals aggregate before one deduction of sample opening pantry stock. The list is an initial shopping calculation, not live purchases or consumption.
Each day retains its own completed stages and elapsed timer state. Day switching, interruption, oven loss and restored equipment use explicit pause/resume recovery.
Serving changes recalculate remaining estimates. Completed stages trigger a quantity review with unestimated rework; reverting quantities preserves progress.
A started-meal change retains the existing meal and groceries until explicit review, then resets only that day. Other planned days are preserved.
The timer updates in place without replacing the active field, uses elapsed time, stops at an elapsed estimate without completing a stage and restores a paused display after browser-cache return.

regression.before: The actual-handler regression reproduced a new salmon recipe incorrectly inheriting the chicken recipe’s completed stage.
regression.after: Explicit change review preserves the current recipe and groceries until confirmation, then resets only its session. The regression and full suite pass.
